verdict.rationale: Audit logs of admin and user actions are a fair question for a community and chat platform like Discord, so the axis applies. However, no evidence item documents an audit log feature. The Gateway API, which streams guild events such as channel updates and role creation, is only a developer building block. It is not a reviewable audit log, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can review audit logs of admin and user actions across the workspace
